exact: cytoplasmic fibers of the nuclear pore complex

definition: Filamentous extensions on cytoplasmic face of the nuclear pore complex (NPC). In S. cerevisiae, Nup159p, Nup82p, and Nup42p contribute to the cytoplasmic filaments. In vertebrates, Nup358 is a major component.
label: nuclear pore cytoplasmic filaments
